Animal · 7 hexes · SM +4 Giant Constrictor Snake [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: snakes; answers Giant Constrictor Snake (SRD 5.1)]

Nine metres of river snake that eats deer whole and has no reason to think a person is different. It comes out of brown water without a sound, takes hold with the jaws, and puts three coils on before anyone upstream has noticed the splash. There is no trick to fighting it — only how fast the coils are cut.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/giant-constrictor-snake.gct
  • Independent build total: 8 points of racial traits plus 18 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Giant Constrictor Snake (SRD 5.1). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Body mass used to scale this build: 250 kg. ST, Size Modifier and DR are checked against it; see the gurps-animal-sanity-check skill for the bands.
  • Movement: ground Move 6 (primary); water Move 6. The published Move is the primary medium's cruising Move; sprint figures are stated here and not folded into it.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • Nine metres, which is the SM +4 row. Note that this is a length reading: the animal is enormous end to end but no wider than a thigh, so it is easy to hit and hard to stop.
  • ST from Basic Lift: the coils have to beat a deer, and then a person who is pulling the other way.
  • Added after a post-hoc comparison against independent GURPS fan conversions of this creature: Double Jointed; the Tracking skill, which a creature with Discriminatory Smell should always have. The comparison surfaced the gap; the build is still ours.
